item.subject: science
item.stem:
During a school game in Chennai, Meena tries to hold her breath under water for a long time, but she cannot do it for more than a few seconds. Which of the following options gives the correct explanation ( )
A. She cannot hold her breath for long because the body needs nitrogen from the air.
B. The body stops functioning the instant a person holds their breath.
C. Holding breath becomes difficult because the body needs oxygen to perform its functions, and humans cannot survive without oxygen for even a few minutes.
D. With oxygen, a person can survive indefinitely without food or water.

options.A: She cannot hold her breath for long because the body needs nitrogen from the air.
options.B: The body stops functioning the instant a person holds their breath.
options.C: Holding breath becomes difficult because the body needs oxygen to perform its functions, and humans cannot survive without oxygen for even a few minutes.
options.D: With oxygen, a person can survive indefinitely without food or water.
